name: phalanx
description: a Phalanx, a Greek-style hoplite: a golden bronze helmet with a tall cream horsehair plume, a golden bronze cuirass with grey-blue pauldrons, a brown pleated leather skirt with white trim, golden greaves, brown boots, a long wooden spear with a steel leaf-shaped head in his RIGHT hand and a tall rectangular wooden shield with gold trim and a gold boss on his LEFT arm
hands: the spear stays in his right hand on the screen-left side and the shield on his left arm on the screen-right side

strike.1: anticipation: weight shifts back onto the rear leg, torso leans back toward the upper-left, the spear is lifted beside the head with its spearhead pointing up and back
strike.2: wind-up extreme: body coiled back and crouched, the spear hand behind the head and the spear hanging back and down behind the shoulders to the left, shield tucked across the belly
strike.3: swing: the front foot steps toward the lower-right, the torso whips round, the spear arm sweeps across in front of the chest and the spear is level, its spearhead pointing to the right
strike.4: contact: spear arm fully extended toward the lower-right, the spear's spearhead striking down-right, front knee bent, body low and leaning in, shield arm swung back behind the shoulders for balance
strike.5: follow-through: the spear carries on down until its spearhead nearly touches the ground at the lower-right, torso twisted, the helmet plume trailing back
strike.6: recover: body rises, front foot pulls back halfway, the spear comes back up on the near side toward the ready angle, shield tucked across the belly

flinch.0: impact: hit from the lower-right; head snaps back toward the upper-left, eyes squeezed shut, torso jolts back, both arms jerk outward (spear arm thrown up and out to the left, shield flung out to the right)
flinch.1: recoil extreme: leaning back further toward the upper-left, knees bent, the spear dipping, shield still held out

death.1: stagger back: a step back toward the upper-left, body thrown back, spear arm flung up, shield drooping
death.2: knees buckle: hips drop, knees fold forward, torso slumps forward, head droops, the spear lowering
death.3: kneeling: on both knees, slumped forward, the spear's spearhead resting on the ground at the lower-right, shield arm hanging
death.4: falling back: torso tips back toward the upper-left, the spear slips out of the hand, legs slide forward
death.5: hits the ground: lying on his back along the ground, feet toward the lower-right and head toward the upper-left; the spear lies on the ground at the lower-right; the shield lies flat beside him
death.7: corpse: lying flat and still on his back, eyes closed, spear and shield on the ground beside him
